repos.description: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。
repos.summary_zh: 《动手学深度学习》是一本面向中文读者的开源深度学习教材，提供可运行代码与交互式学习体验，覆盖数学原理、算法实现与工程实践。该书被全球500多所大学采用，支持中英双语教学，强调批判性思维与动手能力，助力学习者成为具备实战能力的AI应用科学家。
repos.summary_en: Dive into Deep Learning is an open-source textbook designed for Chinese readers, offering executable code and interactive learning. It integrates mathematical theory, algorithmic implementation, and engineering practice, adopted by over 500 universities worldwide. The book emphasizes hands-on learning to cultivate AI application scientists with both theoretical depth and practical skills.

repos.description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
repos.summary_zh: 微舆（BettaFish）是一个从0实现的多Agent舆情分析系统，通过AI驱动的全域社媒监控、复合分析引擎、多模态内容解析及Agent协作机制，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌并预测趋势。系统支持公私域数据融合，具备轻量化Python架构与高扩展性，可快速定制至金融等垂直领域。
repos.summary_en: BettaFish is a zero-to-one implemented multi-Agent public opinion analysis system that breaks information cocoons and predicts trends through AI-driven social media monitoring, hybrid analysis engines, and agent collaboration. It supports private-public data fusion, offers lightweight Python architecture, and enables rapid customization for vertical domains like finance.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: fg-data-profiling 是一个用于 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame 的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，仅需一行代码即可生成包含统计摘要、缺失值、相关性、时间序列和文本分析的详细报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与质量评估。
repos.summary_en: fg-data-profiling is a one-line code tool for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports including statistics, missing values, correlations, time-series, and text analysis, with export options in HTML and JSON for rapid data insights.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含缺失值、相关性、分布统计、时间序列和文本分析的完整报告，支持 HTML/JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 场景。
repos.summary_en: ydata-profiling is a one-line data profiling and exploratory data analysis tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports with type inference, missing data analysis, correlations, distributions, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid EDA.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: data-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值、相关性、时间序列及文本分析的全面报告，输出 HTML/JSON 格式，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 流程。
repos.summary_en: data-profiling is a one-line code solution for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It delivers comprehensive reports with type inference, missing values, correlations, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid data understanding.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款强大的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值分析、统计摘要、可视化图表、时间序列和文本分析的综合报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，显著提升数据理解效率。
repos.summary_en: ydata-profiling is a powerful data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. With just one line of code, it generates comprehensive reports including type inference, missing data analysis, statistical summaries, visualizations, time-series, and text analysis, exportable in HTML and JSON formats for rapid data insights.

repos.description: Rich MySQL Terminal Client with AutoCompletion, Syntax Highlighting, and Dataframes
repos.summary_zh: mycli 是一个专为 MySQL 设计的终端客户端，支持 SQL 关键字、表名、列名的智能自动补全和语法高亮。基于 prompt_toolkit 构建，提供模糊历史搜索、多行查询、查询收藏夹、执行时间统计、SSL 连接支持等功能，并可通过配置文件自定义行为，显著提升数据库交互效率。
repos.summary_en: mycli is a terminal client for MySQL featuring auto-completion for SQL keywords, tables, and columns, along with syntax highlighting. Built with prompt_toolkit, it offers fuzzy history search, multi-line queries, favorite query management, execution timing, SSL support, and customizable config via ~/.myclirc, enhancing database interaction efficiency.

repos.summary_zh: Spark-TTS 是基于 Qwen2.5 大语言模型的高效文本转语音系统，支持中英双语及零样本语音克隆，具备可控语音生成能力。其核心创新在于单流解耦语音标记与 LLM 直接预测音频编码，无需额外声学模型，显著提升推理效率并降低部署复杂度，适用于多语言场景下的语音合成与跨语言迁移。
repos.summary_en: Spark-TTS is an efficient LLM-based text-to-speech model using Qwen2.5 for high-quality, bilingual (Chinese/English) speech synthesis. It supports zero-shot voice cloning and controllable generation (e.g., gender, pitch) with a single-stream decoupled architecture that directly reconstructs audio from LLM-predicted tokens, eliminating the need for separate acoustic models and enabling cross-lingual applications.

repos.summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
repos.summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

repos.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
repos.summary_zh: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是一个 Claude Code Skill，支持将微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown 等 15 种以上内容源自动处理并上传至 Google NotebookLM，生成播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz 等多种输出格式。其核心亮点是内置 6 层付费墙绕过机制，可自动提取 300+ 付费网站内容，结合 AI 实现多模态内容转换。
repos.summary_en: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude Code Skill that processes 15+ content sources—including WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, and Markdown—and uploads them to Google NotebookLM to generate outputs like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its standout feature is a 6-layer paywall bypass system that automatically extracts content from 300+ premium news sites, enabling AI-powered multimodal content transformation.

repos.summary_zh: Pollinations.ai 是一个开源生成式 AI 平台，提供免费的文本到图像、音频、视频和文本生成 API，支持多种模型如 Stable Diffusion 和 Llama。开发者可通过简单 API 调用快速集成 AI 能力，适用于创意项目、应用开发和自动化内容生成，社区活跃且持续扩展应用场景。
repos.summary_en: Pollinations.ai is an open-source generative AI platform offering free APIs for text-to-image, audio, video, and text generation using models like Stable Diffusion and Llama. It enables developers to integrate AI capabilities via simple API calls, supporting creative projects, app development, and automated content creation with an active community and growing ecosystem.

repos.description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，实时更新，导出和修改聊天记录，朋友圈，收藏，自动回复等大量便捷功能
repos.summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
repos.summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

repos.description: A better file browser and calendar inspired by Apple Notes, Bear, Evernote and Day One.
repos.summary_zh: Notebook Navigator 是 Obsidian 的一款插件，用简洁的双窗格界面替代默认文件浏览器，支持文件夹树、标签浏览、文件预览、键盘导航、拖拽操作、固定笔记及高度可定制化显示选项，显著提升笔记管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Notebook Navigator is an Obsidian plugin that replaces the default file explorer with a clean two-pane interface, offering folder tree navigation, tag browsing, file previews, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop, pinned notes, and customizable display options for efficient note management.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: We don't need a lot of libraries. We just need the best ones. | Unofficial recommended first choice.
repos.summary_zh: one-python 精选 Python 生态中最优质的库，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、网络爬虫、数据分析等核心领域，推荐 scikit-learn、TensorFlow、pandas、requests、Scrapy 等高效工具，助力开发者以最少依赖实现强大功能。
repos.summary_en: one-python curates the best Python libraries across key domains like machine learning, deep learning, NLP, web crawling, and data analysis. It recommends top tools such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, pandas, requests, and Scrapy, enabling developers to build powerful applications with minimal dependencies.

repos.description: django-request is a statistics module for django. It stores requests in a database for admins to see, it can also be used to get statistics on who is online etc.
repos.summary_zh: django-request 是一个为 Django 框架设计的网站统计模块，自动记录用户请求至数据库，支持管理员查看访问数据、在线用户统计及流量分析。通过中间件集成和模板标签，可轻松实现用户活跃度监控与访问趋势可视化，适用于需要精细化运营分析的网站项目。
repos.summary_en: django-request is a Django statistics module that logs HTTP requests to a database for admins to analyze. It enables real-time tracking of online users, visitor statistics, and traffic insights via built-in middleware and template tags, ideal for monitoring user engagement and site performance in Django applications.
